test_title: PYST 75: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b473fb09f1ce620bb014669b45b0e3dd83225edad15e3b4d98d2b4e2adba2ed.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: EW – BB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8df20f456c58d32484d310ee3bc960aeee593b516a86e9eae302bb9975980cce.png] 

Option 2: KM – HR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bafa6a94d9f3bb78ff64e2c63a766d1e9104ac1e505de75d4be6b9fa606dc27.png] 

Option 3: QC – NH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1acf402f1005fc11328169fbaddda2a0a4ba86e5eb9e59f026ce67a740c670e.png] 

Option 4: HK – DP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f36723162d327015fc0273d1fa2520bf8a049eef0b6f4c82ffdba3f4ab6e2160.png] 

Thus, HK – DP does not follow the given pattern.

Hence, the odd one out is** Option 4.**
